name: EPIC 6 - Reporting Intelligence & Document Export
description: Provide stakeholders with high-fidelity data visualization, professional document generation, and legacy-compatible data exports.

userStories.title: Backend: Implement GetInventorySnapshotUseCase and Repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the core logic to retrieve a full inventory snapshot optimized for bulk retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement GetInventorySnapshotUseCase in the application layer
Implement repository method findAllActiveStock() in infrastructure utilizing optimized Prisma query selection
Ensure NUMERIC(15,3) fields are handled with decimal.js for backend logic
Logic must support 10,000+ records retrieval
npm run lint passes
npx tsc --noEmit passes
